b4.rule: exact if every seed's summary matches exactly (steady_cost_per_hour, evictions, nodes_removed, final_nodes) in every pair and scenario; equivalent if all six TOSTs at the 3% margin pass after Holm (family B4); otherwise provisional

b4.title: B4 parity in the wild (fine upstream adapters, uncapped) against B2 and B3

h1.rule: supported iff >= 10 of 12 TOSTs are equivalent after Holm (90% CI of the mean paired difference inside +-3% of the heuristic mean; Holm over the 12, p 1 for a test with < 2 pairs) and none is vetoed (unadjusted 90% CI lower bound above +margin)

exp1.title: Random vs heuristic generation under three planners

h3.rule: per scenario and budget: merge+shift lower on integrated_cost_post, significant after Holm over the four (paired Wilcoxon); supported iff all four, partial if some

exp3.title: Merge-only vs merge plus shift at equal pod-eviction budgets

h4.rule: plan clause per scenario: default anneal-plan vs entropy-greedy has significantly lower steady-state cost (Wilcoxon, Holm within H4) and the paired bootstrap 95% upper bound of the percent difference in evictions below +10%; online clause per anneal-online t0 and scenario: significantly more evictions (Wilcoxon, H4) and the bootstrap 95% lower bound of the percent difference in steady-state cost above -1%; an unreachable test makes its clause inconclusive. Supported iff every clause holds, partial if some do

exp4.title: Greedy vs plan-time vs online annealing
